summary: Feed s150_double is degraded: 2 high-severity faults. VLAN 20 missing (50% untagged) and NDR port overloaded by bursts to 16.26 Gbps (163% of 10 Gbps capacity).

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or TAP is stripping 802.1Q tags or trunk is misconfigured to not forward VLAN 20. 50% of packets arrive untagged and VLAN 20 is completely absent despite NDR requiring VLANs 10 and 20.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR loses all visibility into VLAN 20 and cannot correctly segment or correlate traffic by VLAN. Detections for lateral movement and segmentation violations in VLAN 20 will be missed or misattributed.

recommended_fix.why: Restore and preserve 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10 and 20 through the TAP/packet broker so NDR receives correctly tagged traffic for full coverage.

findings.root_cause: Aggregate burst rate of 16.26 Gbps in 1ms intervals exceeds the single 10 Gbps NDR port capacity by 63%. Packet broker is feeding full line-rate bursts to one tool port without load balancing or burst buffering.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR ingress drops during bursts (2 overloaded intervals detected). With needs_full_payload=true and needs_both_directions=true, any drops cause incomplete flows, missed payload inspection, and degraded detection accuracy.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across 2+ NDR ports via hash-based load balancing (or add burst buffering) to keep per-port rate below 80% of 10 Gbps and prevent burst drops while preserving both directions per flow.
